description: Ministry of Public Service Provincial Councils and Local Government - 6 th Amendment of Service Miniute of the Sri Lanka Accountants Service
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Accountants Service, which involves public service recruitment qualifications, examination procedures, and promotion criteria. It is issued by the Public Service Commission and deals specifically with public sector service administration, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8).
